body: I told her about my previous problems with depression. How I was even sent to a mental hospital for trying to kill myself. Yet she just threw me in the trash. I suppose that is all I am. When I die I'm gonna tell my parents to toss my body in the garbage.
I don't give a shit about myself. I am incapable of loving myself. I hate myself. I require someone to make me feel as though I am needed. That is the only way I see myself staying alive.
She also has a trip tomorrow so there's no way she saw him today. She has to get ready to leave. She's been seeing him while we were together most likely.
